tools.name: proverbs.find
tools.description: Use this when someone wants an Akan (Twi) proverb from Ghana about a topic or containing a word: for a speech, a toast, a lesson, a piece of writing or to understand the tradition. Each result has the Twi as printed in 1879 and the English translation of 1916. Do not use it to translate a new senten

tools.name: proverbs.of_the_day
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for an Akan (Twi) proverb without naming a topic, or for a proverb of the day. The same date always gives the same proverb. Do not use it when a topic or a word is given (use proverbs.find), or as a horoscope or a prediction about the day.

tools.name: proverbs.topics
tools.description: Use this when you need to know which topics the Akan proverb collection covers and how many proverbs each has, before searching it. Do not use it to fetch proverbs themselves: use proverbs.find for that.
